title: Chapter 491 - 491 Welcome To The Wedding!

Chapter 491 - 491 Welcome To The Wedding!

Chapter 491 - 491 Welcome to the Wedding!

491 Welcome to the Wedding!

In the blink of an eye, it was Saturday.

After Lin Fan ate breakfast, he drove the Cullinan straight to Washington Palace.

He remembered that he had made an appointment with Su Ningjing to attend her former classmate’s wedding banquet together.

At this moment, Su Ningjing was already waiting in front of the entrance of Washington Palace.

Today, Su Ningjing was wearing a light blue dress and a pair of white shoes. She looked stunning.

Under the sunlight, her body seemed to be wrapped in a layer of silver, looking extremely fresh and pure.

All the people who passed by the gate looked at her.

Su Ningjing ignored the passersby. Her beautiful eyes stared unblinkingly at the road in the distance.

When a tall and sturdy Cullinan drove over, a bright smile immediately appeared on Su Ningjing’s pretty face.

This Cullinan belonged to Lin Fan!

Lin Fan slowly stopped the car and asked, “Ningjing, have you been waiting?”

Su Ningjing shook her head vigorously and said, “I’ve only just arrived.”

Lin Fan looked at the beads of sweat on her forehead and said, “Silly girl.”

After he finished speaking, he lowered the temperature of the air conditioner a little.

Then, he stepped on the accelerator.

…

The Imperial Hotel was the most luxurious hotel in Jiangbei.

Anyone with some assets would choose to hold their wedding here.

This was because only in this way could they display their power and make themselves look good.

Today, Wang Yunfang and Shu Jiadong’s wedding was held here.

Shu Jiadong’s father, Shu Rong, owned a factory with about 50 to 60 employees.

He thought that he was a boss too.

He was the boss, so his son’s wedding naturally had to be grand enough!

Therefore, he paid a huge price to hold the wedding at the Imperial Hotel.

At this moment, Shu Rong was wearing a suit. He was standing at the entrance of the banquet hall on the third floor of the Imperial Hotel with Wang Yunfang and Shu Jiadong, welcoming the guests who were attending the wedding.

“Boss Ma, hahaha! Welcome!”

“I’m not late?”

“No, no! Quick, please come in!”

“President Liu, thank you for coming.”

“Boss Shu, your son’s wedding is such a big event. How could I not come? Is this your daughter-in-law? She’s so beautiful!”

“Thank you for your praise, President Liu…”

Waves of laughter rose and fell. It was extremely lively.

“Tsk!”

Lin Fan parked the Cullinan in the parking lot at the side and walked into the hotel with Su Ningjing.

When they arrived at the entrance of the banquet hall on the third floor, Shu Rong could not help but ask, “You are?”

Coincidentally, Wang Yunfang also looked over and said, “Dad, she’s my former classmate and this is her boyfriend. I’ll just bring them in.”

“Alright.” Shu Rong nodded.

Thus, Wang Yunfang brought Lin Fan and Su Ningjing to the last table.

As Wang Yunfang walked, the gold bracelets on her wrist collided with each other, making a clear sound.

She could not help but complain, “Sigh, it’s not good to have too many gold bracelets. They keep making sounds when I walk. They’re too noisy and too heavy.”

Even though she said that, her face was full of smiles.

Too many gold bracelets, too noisy, too heavy… She was just deliberately showing off.

Su Ningjing’s thoughts were all on Lin Fan. She did not think too deeply about Wang Yunfang’s words.

She handed over a red packet and said, “May you have a blissful marriage.”

Wang Yunfang opened the red packet with a smile and took out five red notes.

“500 yuan? Hehe, sit here.”

She laughed disdainfully and arranged for Lin Fan and Su Ning to sit at the end.

At this moment, there was a commotion at the entrance of the banquet hall.

“Chairman Zhang, Chairman Song, Mr. Wang, Director Liu, Director Li…” Shu Rong shouted in surprise. Why are you here?”

No wonder he was so surprised.

The two men in suits standing at the front were none other than…

It was the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale Market, Zhang Zhou, and the chairman of Yinshan Group, Song Zhifeng!

Last year, the market value of Xiao Wu Wholesale City and Silver Mountain Group exceeded 10 billion!

Now, these two companies had established a partnership with Flower Stem.

As a result, the status and market value of Xiao Wu Wholesale City and Silver Mountain Group greatly increased.

In Shu Rong’s eyes, Zhang Zhou and Song Zhifeng were definitely giants!

Slightly behind them was the general manager of the Imperial Hotel, Wang Fengyi, as well as the higher-ups of Xiao Wu Wholesale City and the Silver Mountain Group.

Zhang Zhou smiled and said, “It’s a happy occasion for you. How can we not come?”

Song Zhifeng smiled and said, “Don’t you welcome us?”

“Yes, we had to attend this wedding banquet,” Wang Fengyi said.

“Welcome, welcome!” Shu Rong hurriedly said.

How could he not welcome them?

It was really too unexpected.

Although Shu Rong considered himself a boss, the few of them had only met twice at some large chambers of commerce and banquets.

Therefore, Shu Rong did not dare to invite Zhang Zhou, Song Zhifeng, Wang Fengyi, and the others to his son’s wedding banquet.

He understood that he was not qualified.

In fact…

That was indeed the case.

The reason why they came over was because they saw Lin Fan walking into the banquet hall when they were taking the elevator.

Who was Lin Fan?

He was the biggest shareholder of Silver Mountain Group and Xiao Wu Wholesale City. He was also the owner of the Imperial Hotel!

Lin Fan had personally come over.

They naturally had to follow him.

….

Wang Yunfang saw that so many people had come at once. Moreover, Shu Rong had become happy. There was even a hint of respect on his face.

“Hubby, who are those people?” she asked curiously.

“Don’t you like to shop at Yinshan Group’s malls?” Shu Jiadong asked. “Don’t you like to buy things at Xiao Wu Wholesale City? Didn’t you ask to hold the wedding at the Imperial Hotel?

“The two in the front are the chairmen of Silver Mountain Group and Xiao Wu Wholesale City! The person behind is the general manager of the Imperial Hotel!”

When he mentioned the background of these people, his tone could not help but become high-spirited.

This was a pride that came from the bottom of his heart!

These big shots were here to attend his wedding!

When Wang Yunfang heard this, an unconcealable excitement surfaced on her face.

The reason why she married Shu Jiadong was because his family owned a factory and he had a good family background.

Now, it seemed that her choice… was right!

Even the chairmen of Silver Mountain Group and Xiao Wu Wholesale City came to attend the wedding in person.

His family’s factory was definitely better than she had imagined!

At this time, Shu Jiadong frowned again and said, “We booked the seats according to the number of guests. With so many guests coming at once, I’m afraid there won’t be enough seats.”
